These intermediates all ultimately target Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, indicating a possible downstream pathway where Ligucyperonol may influence the activity of this transporter. The scores from the different paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with Ligucyperonol being a common upstream activator of the transporter. The evidence is consistent across multiple pathways, reinforcing the likelihood of a functional link between Ligucyperonol and the transporter. However, the exact mechanism by which Ligucyperonol modulates the transporter remains unclear, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the biological relevance of this interaction.
